name: uv-sync
description: uv sync: installs a Python project's environment exactly as its uv.lock pins it.
title: uv-sync

llmHints.on_match: uv sync observed. The lockfiles attestor captures uv.lock; pass --locked (or --frozen) so the install cannot re-resolve past the lock.

positiveSetup: Invoke cilock with argv starting "uv sync"
negativeSetup: Invoke cilock with unrelated argv (e.g. `echo unrelated`)
